description.value:
Requirement chrome-attuned

Duration constant

You've learned how to read as less augmented than you are, when it matters.

While at Hollowed Drift or higher, a Deception check to disguise yourself as unaugmented gains no bonus against you from your visible or audible tells — increase the DC to see through such a disguise by 5.

cinderfall.incomplete: BAND-GAP (the "while at Hollowed Drift+" gate has no predicate regardless of whether the DC-bump half is separately buildable).
